title: The Keeper’s Craft
intro: A restored harbor is a practice, not a perfect machine. Rebuild with what you have learned. You can set a plan or keep each decision in your own hands.
completion: Your charts describe choices as well as coastlines. Future keepers will know why the lights were placed.
hints: Reach 100 Charts and complete five Recharts in total.
Return to a complete five-tier fleet. Automatic resets remain optional.
